svg.text: the bridge: a computer with an ender modem
(a wireless one only hears what's in range)
optional: a wired modem on a cable
to hear that cable's traffic (e.g. the storage network)
the computers and turtles it hears
(anything with a modem sending on rednet)
• It posts what it hears with http.post to tools/overseer/server.mjs on your PC, which shows it in the browser: allow the PC's
address and port in computercraft-server.toml first (see Setup).
• Set overseer.url and overseer.key to the lines the server prints, run 'overseer test', then reboot.
